THE PROJECT

An academic past-question repository, with a signed-in experience for accessing study materials.

The challenge

Past-question materials need a useful place to live, with an interface that helps students orient themselves around their academic resources.

My contribution

I handled full-stack development, working on both the visible interface and the application behind the education project.

QPrep centres on academic past questions, with course information providing context for its study resources.

The sign-in interface provides a focused entry point to the repository, with a consistent visual identity across its account controls.
